speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that. To better understand your condition, can you tell me how long you've had this persistent cough and shortness of breath?

speaker: Patient
text: The cough has been going on for about eight weeks, and the shortness of breath started around the same time. It's not a painful cough, but it does get worse when I try to walk fast or climb stairs. However, the integrated care record from another facility shows confirmed asthma. DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Acute exacerbation of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
